evals.prompt: 用 grok-collage-broll 帮我把这句做成拼贴 B-roll：很多人以为 AI 是来替你思考的，其实它更像一面镜子，会把你问题里的漏洞照出来。
evals.expected_output: At Gate 1, should only propose one clear visual metaphor with key objects, palette and assembly order, then stop for approval. It must not generate an image or call image_gen / image_to_video / reference_to_video yet.

evals.prompt: 上一轮你给的‘知识卡片通过轨道重新连成网络’隐喻我确认了。继续帮我做静帧，底色不要全是蓝色，素材可以有彩色纸片。
evals.expected_output: At Gate 2, should create a varied-color editorial halftone paper-collage visual spec and final still via Grok Build image_gen (aspect_ratio 9:16), save it in the project, show a numbered still contact sheet, and stop for a second approval. It must not call image_to_video or reference_to_video yet.

evals.prompt: 这些彩色拼贴静帧全部通过，帮我继续生成视频。
evals.expected_output: At Gate 3, should default to Grok Build reference_to_video with images=[empty solid first frame, approved still], aspect_ratio 9:16, duration 6s (prefer 720p), strip audio with ffmpeg, create contact sheets and verify the end frame. It must not default to empty-first image_to_video, Gemini Omni Flash, Veo, GEMINI_API_KEY, or google-genai. image_to_video hold on the approved still is only a fallback after end-frame QA failure.

evals.prompt: 这五条里 1、2、4 的隐喻通过，3 和 5 我还想改。先继续下一步。
evals.expected_output: Should advance only items 1, 2 and 4 to still generation while keeping items 3 and 5 at the metaphor revision gate. It must not generate video for any item.
